# Hermes Agent Installation Summary

## Install Commands

- **Linux / macOS / WSL2:**
  ```
  curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash
  ```
- **Windows (native, PowerShell):**
  ```
  iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)
  ```
- **Desktop app:** Download from the Hermes website. On Windows, open the `.appinstaller` file. On macOS, open the DMG and copy `Hermes.app` to Applications.
- **Android / Termux (aarch64):** Configure the signed Termux APT repository, then run `pkg install hermes-agent`.
- **Desktop after a CLI-only install:** `hermes desktop`

**Useful flags:**
- `--channel main` (POSIX) or `-Channel main` (Windows) installs the tip of `main` instead of the latest stable release.
- `--skip-browser` / `-SkipBrowser` and `--skip-computer-use` / `-SkipComputerUse` leave out those tools.
- `--non-interactive` / `-NonInteractive` skips steps that need input.
- `--include-desktop` / `-IncludeDesktop` builds the desktop app from source.
- `--verbose` / `-Verbose` or `HERMES_INSTALL_VERBOSE=1` streams all output.

## What the Source Installer Does

- Clones the source and bootstraps uv, downloading a pinned, verified version.
- Uses PM to provide pinned Python, Node.js, npm, pnpm, ripgrep, and FFmpeg.
- Installs the `all` Python extra.
- Installs a pinned Chromium for local browsing and `cua-driver` (macOS, Windows, and glibc Linux). A failed download doesn't stop the install; the output shows the retry command.
- Creates a launcher and prepares the data directory. Interactive runs also start setup and gateway configuration.
- Writes logs to `logs/install.log` under the Hermes data directory.

**Install locations:**

| Method | Code | Launcher | User data |
|---|---|---|---|
| POSIX script | `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/` | `~/.local/bin/hermes` | `~/.hermes/` |
| Windows script | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\hermes-agent\` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\bin\` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\` |
| Docker | `/opt/hermes/` | Image entrypoint | `/opt/data/` |
| Termux APT | `$PREFIX/lib/hermes-agent/` | `$PREFIX/bin/` | `~/.hermes/` |

`HERMES_HOME` sets the user data location. Windows also accepts `-HermesHome` and `-InstallDir`.

## Prerequisites

- **POSIX script:** Git, curl, tar, and SHA-256 utilities.
- **Windows:** The installer can bootstrap Git for Windows if Git is missing.
- **Python:** Current installs run on Python 3.14. The `pyproject.toml` range (`>=3.11,<3.15`) lets the updater run on older versions, but the page doesn't promise runtime support on 3.11–3.13.
- **Source builds:** May need a native compiler and platform development libraries.
- **glibc Linux:** Minimal Debian, Ubuntu, and RHEL-family images may lack `libatomic.so.1`. The installer installs the distro package (via `sudo -n` if needed). Without sudo, it prints the exact command to run.

## Supported OS

- Linux (glibc and musl, with musl lacking some PM builds)
- macOS, Apple Silicon only (Intel is unsupported)
- Windows (native) and WSL2
- Android on aarch64 via Termux
- Docker and Nix (Nix is best-effort only)

The page points to the Platform Support page for the full matrix.

## Post-Install Steps

1. Reload your shell: `source ~/.bashrc` or `source ~/.zshrc`.
2. Run `hermes` to start chatting.
3. Configure with:
   - `hermes model`: choose the LLM provider and model
   - `hermes tools`: enable tools
   - `hermes gateway setup`: set up messaging platforms
   - `hermes setup`: run the full setup wizard
   - `hermes config set` / `hermes config get`: manage individual values
4. Run `hermes doctor` for diagnostics. After an update, run `hermes config check` and `hermes config migrate`.

## Supported Model Providers

The page doesn't list model providers in full, and it says nothing about Anthropic/Claude, including whether it works with an API key or an OAuth/subscription login. Here's what it does mention:

- **Nous Portal:** One subscription covers 300+ models and the Tool Gateway. Run `hermes setup --portal`.
- **OpenRouter:** Configurable with `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
- **Other providers:** Selected through `hermes model`.

For Anthropic/Claude specifics, run `hermes model` or check the provider documentation.

## Anthropic

**Eligibility**
- **Claude Max with purchased extra usage credits:** The OAuth path works only if you have both. The docs say it "only works if you're on a Claude Max plan and have purchased extra usage credits."
- **Claude Pro:** Cannot use the OAuth path.
- **Team and Enterprise:** The docs don't address these plans.
- **API key:** Works regardless of subscription, billed pay-per-token at standard API pricing.

**Claude Code credentials**
- Yes, Hermes can reuse them. When you choose Anthropic OAuth in `hermes model`, Hermes uses Claude Code's credential store instead of copying the token into `~/.hermes/.env`, so refreshable credentials stay refreshable.
- Hermes also auto-detects Claude Code credential files if you already use Claude Code.
- Hermes-owned OAuth grants take precedence. The borrowed Claude Code login is a fallback, and you can disable it with `auth.adopt_external_logins: false`.

**Billing**
- **OAuth:** Only the extra/overage credits you've purchased are consumed. The base Max allowance is not used by Hermes.
- **API key:** Pay-per-token against that key's organization.

**Commands**

```bash
# API key (pay-per-token)
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...
hermes chat --provider anthropic --model claude-sonnet-4-6

# Preferred for OAuth: authenticate through the wizard
hermes model

# Manual setup-token (fallback/legacy)
export ANTHROPIC_TOKEN=...
hermes chat --provider anthropic

# OAuth via the credential pool
hermes auth add anthropic --type oauth
```

`--provider claude` and `--provider claude-code` are aliases for `anthropic`.

## Other providers

**Cloud, API key:** OpenRouter, Fireworks AI, NovitaAI, Ramp Router, AI Gateway, z.ai/GLM, Kimi/Moonshot, Arcee AI, GMI Cloud, Nebius, MiniMax, xAI (Grok), Alibaba DashScope/Coding Plan/Token Plan, Kilo Code, Xiaomi MiMo, Tencent TokenHub/TokenPlan, OpenCode Zen/Go, CommandCode, DeepSeek, Hugging Face, Google Gemini, OpenAI API, NVIDIA NIM, StepFun, DeepInfra, and Actual Computer.

**Cloud, OAuth or cloud billing:** Nous Portal (one subscription covering 300+ models), OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT subscription), xAI Grok OAuth (SuperGrok/Premium+), Qwen OAuth, MiniMax OAuth, Google Vertex AI (GCP billing), AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, and Ollama Cloud.

**Local:**
- **Ollama:** Simple setup. Needs a context window of at least 64K, set server-side.
- **LM Studio:** Desktop GUI.
- **llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang:** Self-hosted servers. Tool calling requires specific flags.

**Free options:**
- **Local models** (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp): No API fees, but they need your own hardware.
- **Hugging Face:** Free tier with a $0.10/month credit.
- **Google Gemini free tier:** Limited quota, which the docs say can run out quickly during agent sessions.

content.content:
**Team plan credit**
- **Standard seat:** $20/month. **Premium seat:** $100/month.
- Credits are pooled into one balance, capped at $500/month.
- Example: three Standard and two Premium seats receive $260/month. Adding one Premium seat raises that to $360.
- Discounted Nonprofit and Scientists Team plans earn the same per-seat amounts.

**Max plan credit**
- Max 5x: $100/month. Max 20x: $200/month.

**Eligibility**
- Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans are not eligible.
- New subscribers can claim after 7 days on an eligible plan.
- Plans bought through the iOS or Android apps qualify, but the claim must be made on claude.ai in a browser.

**Claiming and where credits apply**
- You claim by linking one Claude Console organization to the plan. The article says you can't change the linked organization yourself; changing it later requires contacting support, so link the one you plan to build in.
- Each plan links to one organization, and each organization draws from one plan.
- The article doesn't say exactly where the balance appears in the Console.

**What they can be spent on**
- The Claude API, Claude Managed Agents, the Claude Agent SDK, and the playground, on any of Anthropic's models.

**What they can't be spent on**
- Claude Code, extra usage inside the Claude apps, and Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Foundry.
- The credits don't change existing usage limits in Claude or Claude Code.
- The article doesn't say whether API keys or third-party tools are covered beyond the products listed above.

**Expiry and rollover**
- Unused credit doesn't roll over. It expires at the end of each billing cycle, or monthly for annual plans.
- When the balance runs out and no purchased credits remain, API requests stop until the next monthly credits arrive. Usage is never charged to the Claude plan.

**Rate limits**
- Linked organizations move up to at least the Start tier, or to at least Build if monthly credits exceed $200. A $200 Max 20x allowance doesn't meet that threshold.
- Credit-paid usage still counts toward the organization's monthly spend cap, which resets on the calendar month's first day, while credits refresh on the billing cycle.

**Start date**
- The change was listed in Anthropic's platform release notes on October 7, and the article says it reaches all eligible Max and Team subscribers during the week of October 7. Not everyone will see it at once.

기억하시는 500달러는 추가 사용량이 아니라 API 크레딧입니다. 그리고 그쪽이 헤르메스에는 오히려 더 잘 맞습니다.

**Team 요금제 월 API 크레딧 (10월 7일부터)**
- Premium 좌석마다 월 100달러가 쌓이고, 조직 전체 상한이 500달러입니다. Jubal은 Premium 2좌석이라 **월 200달러**입니다.
- Claude API, 즉 API 키로 쓰는 곳에 쓸 수 있으니 헤르메스에서 쓸 수 있습니다. 다 쓰면 요청이 멈출 뿐, 요금제로 추가 청구되지 않습니다. 남은 크레딧은 다음 달로 넘어가지 않습니다.
- Claude Code와 앱 안의 추가 사용량에는 쓸 수 없습니다.

**"돌려서" 쓰는 길(Claude 계정 로그인)은 권하지 않습니다**
- 지금 Claude Code는 Jubalfx 계정(소유자)으로 로그인되어 있고, 추가 사용량이 켜져 있습니다.
- 헤르메스가 이 로그인을 빌려 쓰면, 그 요청은 위 200달러가 아니라 **추가 사용량(실제 돈)**으로 청구됩니다. 공짜 한도 안에서 쓰는 셈이 되지 않습니다.
- 헤르메스는 Claude Code 로그인을 자동으로 찾아 쓸 수 있습니다. 실수로 청구되지 않도록 설치 후 `auth.adopt_external_logins: false`로 꺼 두겠습니다.

**제안 순서**
1. 설치: 아래 명령을 직접 입력해 주셔야 합니다(자동 모드에서 막혔습니다).
   ```
   ! bash /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jjunu/a9b3a323-2e31-4d78-a2fb-762e671bab9b/scratchpad/hermes-dl/install.sh --non-interactive
   ```
2. 크레딧 받기: claude.ai를 브라우저로 열고 Claude Console 조직을 연결합니다. **한 번 연결하면 직접 바꿀 수 없고 고객지원을 거쳐야 하니**, Jubal용 Console 조직으로 고르셔야 합니다.
3. 그 Console 조직에서 API 키를 만들고, 헤르메스에 Anthropic API 키 방식으로 연결합니다.

200달러는 [팀원] 님 좌석분까지 합친 공동 크레딧입니다. 개인용으로도 쓰신다면 [팀원] 님께 한마디 해 두시는 편이 좋겠습니다.

You have access to browser automation tools (mcp__claude-in-chrome__*) for interacting with web pages in Chrome. Follow these guidelines for effective browser automation.

## Loading deferred tools

If the mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load every tool you expect to need in ONE ToolSearch call — the select query accepts a comma-separated list — never one call per tool. Start with the core set:

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting.

## GIF recording

When performing multi-step browser interactions that the user may want to review or share, use mcp__claude-in-chrome__gif_creator to record them.

You must ALWAYS:
* Capture extra frames before and after taking actions to ensure smooth playback
* Name the file meaningfully to help the user identify it later (e.g., "login_process.gif")

## Console log debugging

You can use mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages to read console output. Console output may be verbose. If you are looking for specific log entries, use the 'pattern' parameter with a regex-compatible pattern. This filters results efficiently and avoids overwhelming output. For example, use pattern: "[MyApp]" to filter for application-specific logs rather than reading all console output.

## Alerts and dialogs

IMPORTANT: Do not trigger JavaScript alerts, confirms, prompts, or browser modal dialogs through your actions. These browser dialogs block all further browser events and will prevent the extension from receiving any subsequent commands. Instead, when possible, use console.log for debugging and then use the mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages tool to read those log messages. If a page has dialog-triggering elements:
1. Avoid clicking buttons or links that may trigger alerts (e.g., "Delete" buttons with confirmation dialogs)
2. If you must interact with such elements, warn the user first that this may interrupt the session
3. Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__javascript_tool to check for and dismiss any existing dialogs before proceeding

If you accidentally trigger a dialog and lose responsiveness, inform the user they need to manually dismiss it in the browser.

## Avoid rabbit holes and loops

When using browser automation tools, stay focused on the specific task. If you encounter any of the following, stop and ask the user for guidance:
- Unexpected complexity or tangential browser exploration
- Browser tool calls failing or returning errors after 2-3 attempts
- No response from the browser extension
- Page elements not responding to clicks or input
- Pages not loading or timing out
- Unable to complete the browser task despite multiple approaches

Explain what you attempted, what went wrong, and ask how the user would like to proceed. Do not keep retrying the same failing browser action or explore unrelated pages without checking in first.

Nous Research의 오픈소스 에이전트 **Hermes Agent**를 맥(Apple M5)에 설치하고 모델을 연결한 기록입니다. Claude Code와 함께 진행했습니다.

## 설치

- 공식 설치 스크립트를 먼저 내려받아 내용을 확인한 뒤 실행
  ```
  curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh -o install.sh
  bash install.sh --non-interactive
  ```
- 결과: Hermes Agent v0.23.2 (Python 3.14.9), 코드 `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/`, 명령 `~/.local/bin/hermes`, 설정 `~/.hermes/config.yaml`

## 모델 연결

| 단계 | 내용 |
| --- | --- |
| 지금 | ChatGPT 무료 계정 OAuth (`openai-codex` 제공자) → 모델 `gpt-5.6-luna` |
| 나중 | Claude Team 요금제 월 API 크레딧이 열리면(가입 7일 뒤, 11/22쯤) Console 조직 연결 → API 키로 `anthropic` 제공자 전환 |

```
hermes config set auth.adopt_external_logins false   # Claude Code 로그인 자동 사용 끄기
hermes auth add openai-codex --browser                # ChatGPT 로그인 (브라우저 승인)
hermes config set model.provider openai-codex
hermes config set model.default gpt-5.6-luna
```

### 알게 된 점

- **Claude 구독 로그인은 못 씀**: Hermes 문서상 Claude 계정 OAuth는 Max + 추가 사용량 크레딧 전용이고, 기본 사용량이 아닌 추가 크레딧만 소모. Pro는 불가, Team은 언급 없음. Claude Code 로그인을 자동으로 가져다 쓰면 의도치 않게 추가 요금이 나갈 수 있어 꺼 둠.
- **Team 요금제 API 크레딧**: Max·Team 구독에 월 API 크레딧이 붙음(Claude Code·앱 추가 사용량에는 못 씀, API·Agent SDK용). 다 쓰면 멈출 뿐 추가 청구 없음 → Hermes에 적합.
- **ChatGPT 기기 코드 로그인**은 ChatGPT 보안 설정에서 따로 켜야 함 → `--browser`(PKCE) 방식으로 우회.
- **무료 계정 모델 제한**: `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.4-mini` 등은 HTTP 400 "not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account". `gpt-5.6-luna`는 됨.

## 확인

```
hermes chat -q "현재 폴더의 파일 목록을 터미널 도구로 확인하고 한 줄로 알려줘." --oneshot
```
→ 터미널 도구를 호출해 `docs, sessions`를 답함 (도구 호출 정상)

## 파일

| 경로 | 내용 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/` | Claude Code 작업 대화 기록 (개인정보 가림) |
| `sessions/` | 대화 기록 원본 (git 제외) |

# Telegram Setup

Hermes Agent integrates with Telegram as a full-featured conversational bot. Once connected, you can chat with your agent from any device, send voice memos that get auto-transcribed, receive scheduled task results, and use the agent in group chats. The integration is built on [python-telegram-bot](https://python-telegram-bot.org/) and supports text, voice, images, and file attachments.

## Quick setup (dashboard and desktop app)

The **Messaging → Telegram** page in the [dashboard](../features/web-dashboard.md) and the [desktop app](../desktop.md) has a **Create with QR** button. Scan the code (or open the link) in Telegram; Hermes creates the bot for you, detects your Telegram user ID, writes `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` and `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS` into your profile's `.env`, and restarts the gateway. If you prefer to create the bot yourself, follow the manual steps below.

## Hermes Cloud with Team Gateway

On a Hermes Cloud instance with Team Gateway on, Telegram (and Discord and Slack) reach your agent through a shared Hermes bot. A bot of your own does not run there: the gateway switches direct connections off at every start so the instance can sleep when idle. The Telegram card shows **Via Team Gateway** instead of **Create with QR**.

When Nous Portal manages who can reach the agent (agents created in the Portal), link your account from the Portal: the card lists the linked accounts and its **Link accounts in Nous Portal** button opens the agent there. Use **Message platforms** on the agent to get the link code.

Otherwise the card links the account itself:

1. Click **Link Telegram**. Hermes shows a one-time message such as `/link AB12CD`, a QR code and an **Open Telegram** button.
2. Scan the QR code with your phone (or click the button) to open the shared bot, and send it that message from the Telegram account you want to use.
3. The card lists the account once the bot sees the message. From then on, message the shared bot to talk to your agent.

The gateway must be running for the button to work, because it holds the Team Gateway connection. To run your own bot beside the shared one instead, set `GATEWAY_RELAY_ALLOW_DIRECT_PLATFORMS=true` in the instance's environment. That keeps a live Telegram connection open, so the instance never sleeps.

## Step 1: Create a Bot via BotFather

Every Telegram bot requires an API token issued by [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather), Telegram's official bot management tool.

1. Open Telegram and search for **@BotFather**, or visit [t.me/BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather)
2. Send `/newbot`
3. Choose a **display name** (e.g., "Hermes Agent") — this can be anything
4. Choose a **username** — this must be unique and end in `bot` (e.g., `my_hermes_bot`)
5. BotFather replies with your **API token**. It looks like this:

```
123456789:ABCdefGHIjklMNOpqrSTUvwxYZ
```

:::warning
Keep your bot token secret. Anyone with this token can control your bot. If it leaks, revoke it immediately via `/revoke` in BotFather.
:::

## Step 2: Customize Your Bot (Optional)

These BotFather commands improve the user experience. Message @BotFather and use:

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `/setdescription` | The "What can this bot do?" text shown before a user starts chatting |
| `/setabouttext` | Short text on the bot's profile page |
| `/setuserpic` | Upload an avatar for your bot |
| `/setcommands` | Define the command menu (the `/` button in chat) |
| `/setprivacy` | Control whether the bot sees all group messages (see Step 3) |

:::tip
For `/setcommands`, a useful starting set:

```
help - Show help information
new - Start a new conversation
sethome - Set this chat as the home channel
```
:::

### Online/Offline status indicator (Optional)

Telegram bots have no real online/offline presence dot — that green dot is a
*user-account* feature, not something the Bot API exposes for bots. The closest
surface is the bot's **short description** (the line shown under its name in the
bot's profile).

Enable `status_indicator` and Hermes sets that short description to **Online**
when the gateway connects and **Offline** on a clean shutdown:

```yaml
gateway:
  platforms:
    telegram:
      extra:
        status_indicator: true
        # Optional custom strings (defaults: "Online" / "Offline"):
        status_online: "🟢 Online"
        status_offline: "🔴 Offline"
```

Notes:

- The short description is **global** to the bot (visible to all users), not
  per-chat. Users see it on the bot's profile page, not as a live badge inside
  an open chat.
- Only a **clean** gateway shutdown (`/stop`, `disconnect`) writes "Offline".
  A hard crash leaves the last-known status — the inherent limitation of a
  profile-text indicator.
- Off by default, since it mutates the bot's global profile.
- Hermes saves the bot's own short description (the one set in @BotFather) before
  it first writes **Online**, and keeps that copy across restarts and crashes.
  Turn `status_indicator` off and the next connect puts your text back, unless
  you have set a new description in @BotFather since (yours is kept). Edit the
  description while the gateway is down and the new text is what Hermes saves.
  If Hermes cannot read and save your text at connect, it writes no status that run.

### Cold-boot pending queue (Optional)

Messages sent while the gateway is off (a desktop shut down overnight, a
restart, an update) wait in Telegram's Bot API queue for up to 24 hours. By
default the adapter keeps that queue on a cold boot and answers the backlog
in order once it starts; updates Hermes already handled before the restart
are skipped by its persisted update receipts, so they are not answered twice.

Set `drop_pending_on_cold_boot: true` to discard that backlog on startup
instead (an always-on server where a restart means "start clean"):

```yaml
platforms:
  telegram:
    extra:
      drop_pending_on_cold_boot: true
```

Notes:

- Default is `false`: the backlog is answered. An explicit value in your
  config is respected either way.
- Watcher reconnects (brief network outages with the process still alive)
  always preserve the queue regardless of this setting.
- Conflict recovery (another poller holding the bot's `getUpdates` session)
  also preserves the queue: messages sent during a 409 conflict are delivered
  once polling resumes.
- After a crash, a preserved queue can redeliver an update the crashed
  instance partially processed. Telegram's offset usually prevents this,
  but time-sensitive commands sent during a long outage will run on boot.

### Concurrent update handling

Updates from different chats are processed concurrently, so one slow turn
(a long provider retry, a large download) no longer stalls every other chat.

텔레그램 연결 방법을 확인했습니다. 봇 만들기와 토큰 입력은 직접 해 주셔야 하고, 나머지는 제가 하겠습니다. 토큰은 봇 비밀번호와 같아서, 채팅에 붙여 넣지 마시고 설정 화면에 직접 넣어 주십시오.

**1. 봇 만들기 (텔레그램 앱)**
- [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather)에게 `/newbot`을 보냅니다.
- 표시 이름은 아무거나 괜찮습니다(예: Hermes).
- 사용자명은 `bot`으로 끝나야 합니다(예: `jjunu_hermes_bot`).
- 답장으로 오는 토큰(`123456789:ABC...` 형태)을 복사해 둡니다.

**2. 내 텔레그램 ID 확인**
- [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot)에게 아무 말이나 보내면 숫자 ID가 옵니다.
- 이 ID를 허용 목록에 넣어야 다른 사람이 봇을 써서 이 맥을 조종하지 못합니다.

**3. 헤르메스에 넣기**
- 프롬프트에 아래를 입력하고, Telegram을 고른 뒤 토큰과 ID를 넣어 주십시오.
  ```
  ! ~/.local/bin/hermes gateway setup
  ```
- 끝난 뒤 백그라운드 서비스 설치를 물으면 "아니오"를 골라 주십시오. 서비스 설치와 시험은 제가 이어서 하겠습니다.

미리 알려 드릴 점이 두 가지 있습니다.

편한 방법을 고르시면 됩니다.

1. **휴대폰 텔레그램 앱**: 가장 간단합니다. 검색창에 `BotFather`와 `userinfobot`을 쳐서 찾으면 됩니다. 이름 옆에 파란 체크가 있는 공식 계정인지 확인해 주십시오. 받은 토큰을 맥에 옮길 때는 텔레그램 "저장한 메시지(Saved Messages)"에 보내 두면 편합니다.

# Hermes Agent 세팅 (11.18)

Nous Research의 오픈소스 에이전트 **Hermes Agent**를 맥(Apple M5)에 설치하고 모델을 연결한 기록입니다. Claude Code와 함께 진행했습니다.

## 설치

- 공식 설치 스크립트를 먼저 내려받아 내용을 확인한 뒤 실행
  ```
  curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh -o install.sh
  bash install.sh --non-interactive
  ```
- 결과: Hermes Agent v0.23.2 (Python 3.14.9), 코드 `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/`, 명령 `~/.local/bin/hermes`, 설정 `~/.hermes/config.yaml`

## 모델 연결

| 단계 | 내용 |
| --- | --- |
| 지금 | ChatGPT 무료 계정 OAuth (`openai-codex` 제공자) → 모델 `gpt-5.6-luna` |
| 나중 | Claude Team 요금제 월 API 크레딧이 열리면(가입 7일 뒤, 11/22쯤) Console 조직 연결 → API 키로 `anthropic` 제공자 전환 |

```
hermes config set auth.adopt_external_logins false   # Claude Code 로그인 자동 사용 끄기
hermes auth add openai-codex --browser                # ChatGPT 로그인 (브라우저 승인)
hermes config set model.provider openai-codex
hermes config set model.default gpt-5.6-luna
```

### 알게 된 점

- **Claude 구독 로그인은 못 씀**: Hermes 문서상 Claude 계정 OAuth는 Max + 추가 사용량 크레딧 전용이고, 기본 사용량이 아닌 추가 크레딧만 소모. Pro는 불가, Team은 언급 없음. Claude Code 로그인을 자동으로 가져다 쓰면 의도치 않게 추가 요금이 나갈 수 있어 꺼 둠.
- **Team 요금제 API 크레딧**: Max·Team 구독에 월 API 크레딧이 붙음(Claude Code·앱 추가 사용량에는 못 씀, API·Agent SDK용). 다 쓰면 멈출 뿐 추가 청구 없음 → Hermes에 적합.
- **ChatGPT 기기 코드 로그인**은 ChatGPT 보안 설정에서 따로 켜야 함 → `--browser`(PKCE) 방식으로 우회.
- **무료 계정 모델 제한**: `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.4-mini` 등은 HTTP 400 "not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account". `gpt-5.6-luna`는 됨.

**할 수 있는 일**
- **맥에서 직접 작업**: 터미널 명령, 파일 읽기와 쓰기, 웹 검색, 브라우저 조작을 합니다. 예를 들어 밖에서 "jubal 저장소 git status 알려줘"나 "Downloads에 있는 PDF 요약해줘" 같은 일을 시킬 수 있습니다.
- **기본 탑재 스킬 44개**: Apple 메모, 미리 알림, iMessage, 나의 찾기, 옵시디언, GitHub, 유튜브 요약, arXiv 논문 찾기, 이메일 정리, 주간 계획 등이 들어 있습니다. 예를 들어 "볼트의 OBL 정리 노트에서 9장 핵심만 뽑아줘"나 "내일 3시 합주 미리 알림 추가해줘" 같은 일입니다.
- **예약 작업**: 정해진 시간에 일을 하고 결과를 텔레그램으로 보내 줍니다. 예를 들어 매일 아침 일정과 마감 정리, 특정 웹페이지 변화 감시, 가격 추적을 맡길 수 있습니다. 지금 파이에서 돌리는 공지 감시 같은 일을 말로 만들 수 있는 셈입니다.
- **기억**: 대화 내용과 선호를 스스로 기억하고, 자주 하는 일은 스킬로 만들어 둡니다. 쓸수록 손에 익는 구조입니다.
- **음성 메모**: 텔레그램으로 음성을 보내면 글로 받아 적은 뒤 처리합니다.
